_doc: MEASURED cost to find, per partition: active minutes per unit of currency, where a unit is one class-4 find and a class-3 is worth a tenth of one. This file is EVIDENCE — the aggregate a finished run actually spent — and nothing reads it at run time. `cost_to_find.json` is the regularized seed derived from it, and that is what a run is handed. Regenerate with `fractal-wallpapers derive-prices`; never hand-edit a row.

_provenance.estimand: sum(minutes) / sum(units), pooled across the source runs

source_runs.name: steady-state run 27
source_runs.note: the source project's last steady-state production run, 183 wall minutes; the first of its runs to price both degree-2 partitions, which is why no row in it is defaulted

_provenance.defaulted_note: fewer than min_units currency units found in the source runs, so the row carries seed_price and states nothing about the partition. `phoenix:classic` is externally supplied: no walk ever serves it, so no walk can ever price it, and its row is permanently a stated absence rather than a measurement waiting to arrive.
_provenance.min_units_note: one whole class-4's worth of currency is the evidence floor to be priced. There is deliberately no magnitude bound: the source project measured four partitions at 0.078-0.139 min/unit off 62-148 units, and a [seed/4, seed*4] band would have reported 0.75 for every one of them — a bound cannot tell `implausible` from `the thing the run was run to find out`.
